remarks: Well-maintained two-family Colonial offering strong owner-occupant or investment opportunity. Property has been kept in great condition consistent with prior updates, featuring original character with revitalized moldings, hardwood floors, and functional layouts in both units. First floor unit offers an open living/dining layout, 1 bedroom and access to a private deck, with additional finished lower level space (approx. 732 SF) including multiple rooms and laundry. Second unit, upper level with 2 bedrooms, updated bath, and private deck. Recent improvements include partially renewed sewer line and a brand new furnace for the lower unit. Situated on an expansive lot with a tiered backyard and classic front porch. Sale includes two contiguous parcels (2-87-14-0 & 2-87-15-0) under single ownership, providing added flexibility and long-term value potential. Convenient to downtown SONO dining, train, and waterfront.
